answer_1.quote: Natural Language Generation (NLG) module converts these actions into an utterance, which is surfaced to the user.

answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we use BLEU and Slot Error Rate (SER) as automatic metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation study via crowd sourcing.
answer_4.guideline: they are asked to rate each response on a scale of 1 (bad) to 3 (good) along two axes - informativeness and naturalness.
